# CritABCD

> CritABCD is an IB Middle Years Programme (MYP) e-assessment and self-study platform. It offers past papers, AI-powered grading against the IB assessment criteria (A–D), instant feedback, topic- and criterion-level practice, and simulated exams across the MYP subject groups.

CritABCD is for MYP students (roughly ages 11–16) and their teachers. Work is assessed against the four IB MYP criteria (A, B, C, D), each scored 1–8, rather than raw percentage marks.

## Subjects
- Physics — MYP past papers, topic and criterion practice, simulated exams with AI marking.
- Chemistry — MYP past papers, topic and criterion practice, simulated exams with AI marking.
- Biology — MYP past papers, topic and criterion practice, simulated exams with AI marking.
- Individuals & Societies (Humanities) — integrated humanities past papers and practice.
- Geography — MYP Individuals & Societies past papers and practice.
- Design — a project-based self-study module for MYP Years 4–5. Students study worked exemplar projects and then build their own design folder through the design cycle: Criterion A (Inquiring and analysing), B (Developing ideas), C (Creating the solution), and D (Evaluating).

## How it works
- Practice by topic (filter questions by concept) or by IB criterion (target a specific A–D skill).
- Take full simulated exams under timed conditions with AI grading and instant, criterion-referenced feedback.
- The Design module offers a dual path: follow the guided course, or open any standalone project; each project can be studied (worked exemplar) or built (your own scaffolded design folder) with rubric self-assessment.

- Home: https://critabcd.com/

- Resources (interactive quizzes, simulations and labs): https://critabcd.com/resources

## FAQ
- What is CritABCD? CritABCD is an IB Middle Years Programme (MYP) e-assessment and self-study platform offering past papers, AI-graded practice and instant, criterion-referenced feedback.
- Which subjects does CritABCD cover? Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Individuals & Societies (Humanities), Geography, and a project-based Design self-study module.
- How is my work graded? Against the four IB MYP criteria (A, B, C, D), each scored 1–8, with AI feedback tied to each criterion rather than a single percentage.
- What is the MYP Design module? A project-based self-study module for MYP Years 4–5: study worked exemplars, then build your own design folder through the design cycle (Criteria A–D).
- Who is CritABCD for? IB MYP students (roughly ages 11–16) and their teachers.
- Can I take full practice exams? Yes — simulated exams under timed conditions with AI marking and instant feedback.
- How do I practise a specific topic or criterion? Practise by topic (filter by concept) or by IB criterion (target a specific A–D skill), then attempt a full simulated exam.
